title: OpenDesign product site — local vibe-design workspace for 21+ agents
summary: Marketing site for OpenDesign, an Apache-2.0 local-first vibe design workspace that routes 21+ coding agents through composable skills and portable DESIGN.md files. Contrasts with hosted Claude Design by keeping prototypes, landings, slides, and brand artifacts as repo files with BYOK.
question_it_answers: What is OpenDesign and how does its local file-based vibe design workspace differ from hosted Claude Design?

claims.text: OpenDesign supports 21+ coding agents for prototypes, landing pages, slides, dashboards, and brand systems.
claims.evidence: turns 21+ coding agents into a design engine for prototypes, landing pages, slides, dashboards, HTML video, and brand systems
claims.subject: design-agent-skills

claims.text: Artifacts stay as portable DESIGN.md files in your repo instead of a hosted locked model.
claims.evidence: Where Claude Design is closed/hosted/model-locked, OpenDesign runs locally; artifacts land as files in your repo.
claims.subject: design-agent-skills
